question: What certainty accompanies the attainment of diverse desired outcomes?
premises: The agent obtains the desired outcome.
The desired outcome may be various in kind.
No doubt exists regarding this attainment.
inference: Whatever diverse thing is desired is certainly obtained.
uncertainties: The implicit subject of labhati is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: One indeed obtains whatever various thing is desired; there is no doubt.
